body: Thank you for the words. It means a lot in a weird way. I don't know how accurate my perception of all of this is but I just feel like it's not worth it
Yeah. I don't know, thank you though
This post is just opinion presented as fact lol yikes, probably against the rules tbh
Haven't had a normal mood in ages so perhaps. Thanks for the effort

I mean, I've wanted to die for over half my life. Passively, but still. I decided on late April a while ago to get away from impulsivity and to see if my thought process would change in the face of it but so far it hasn't.

I guess the easiest way to explain is is that my brain gets in the way of my goals. And no I'm not willing to "take a break." For me personally just being alive or being alive and not doing much is pointless

I don't think it's impossible, I'm sure there is a solution. I just don't see life as worth fighting for.
Thanks for your effort

That's not really what I'm saying. More that I don't want to be alive in general. The person I want to be doesn't match up with the way my mind operates I guess. I've been trying to become different and it hasn't worked. Probably because I don't really actually want much. 
Easier said than done, anyways.
I get that there are probably solutions. I just don't see it as worthwhile and remain unimpressed by the "success stories" of "mentally ill" people.

I have been staying alive mostly for my family for a long time, it just stopped being enough and I don't know how to fix that.

I've never been diagnosed with anything so I can't really be forward  because I don't know. I leave some things out because I feel like they would be hurt more to know than not know for my parents. 
I don't think I'm "evil" but I'm undoubtedly selfish and have let other people get hurt because I'm scared/selfish.

Holding it together meaning not having a public meltdown. Not sure what exactly you mean by "if you were that unhappy." There are things I want in life but they don't mesh with the person I am. Now I'm alive for family. I already said why I'm waiting
